chapter: Radio color line, San Francisco and Columbia staff
title: Concerts with Benny Goodman's small group
summary: Benny Goodman asked for Lee, and with Mel Powell, Red Callender and Red Norvo he played concerts at the Shrine and Long Beach.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: So it was during the time I was there that I did a lot of things with Mel Powell, and Benny Goodman came over and asked -- he wanted me to do some concerts with him, and so I told him he had to ask Morris Stoloff. Well, you know, if a guy's on the staff at the studio, and Benny Goodman comes in and requests him, then the whole studio is just up in the air, you know, because the King of Swing wants one of our musicians out of our band.

And so they left me off for a couple of weeks and I did concerts you know, here on the coast. It was Benny, Red Norva Nobel, Red Callendar, and Mel Powell. So we did at the Shrine Auditorium, we did at Long Beach, and San Bernardino and I forget where else.
A funny little thing about Benny -- we did the

concert at Long Beach first, I think it was, you know, and just absolutely broke it up. Because at that time, I was quite a soloist, quite a soloist,and I changed my style later. And I was doing fours and things like that with Benny, and we just tore it up in Long Beach.
